summary: Allocates a 16-byte-per-entry table via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * a1) and fills each entry with adjacent source indices and two blend weights for bilinear interpolation. Fractional source coordinate v6 = v15 * (a2/a1) - 0.5 is passed through sub_5895A2; edge clamping/wrapping depends on flag a3. Used by sub_5054EC and VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation.

local_names.a3: edge mode flag (nonzero wraps last index, zero clamps)
local_names.v4: walking int pointer across 16-byte table entries

operations.description: Allocate the coordinate table with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * a1) bytes (16 bytes per entry)
If the allocation returns NULL, return NULL immediately without filling the table
Store stack value v5 (read from uninitialized slot v14) into workspace global dword_8B0098
Iterate v15 from 0 while v15 < a1, producing one table entry per iteration
Compute fractional source coordinate v6 = v15 * v11 - 0.5
Call sub_5895A2(v6) to compute the fractional interpolation value from the coordinate
Edge handling: when first index v7 < 0, set v7 = a2 - 1 if a3 nonzero else 0
Edge handling: when second index v8 >= a2, set v8 = a2 - 1 if a3 zero else 0
Store first adjacent source index v7 at the entry's int slot 0 and second adjacent source index v8 at the entry's int slot 2
Store blend weight v9 = 1.0 - (v13 - v12) at the entry's float slot +4 and complementary weight 1.0 - v9 at the entry's float slot +12, then advance v4 by 4 ints to the next entry
Return the filled table base pointer v10 to the caller
Invoked by sub_5054EC (005054EC) and VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation (005058D2) to build the interpolation coordinate table used during vertex stage transformation
